final_answer.key_evidence_summary: ts-price-service is the only outlier workload (pod ts-price-service-69f6579f8-xv9gc, 0/2 READY, STATUS Error, 4 restarts, CrashLoopBackOff with Last State Terminated exit code 1 on node worker-01). Its container log shows 'java.net.UnknownHostException: tsdb-mysql-leader: Temporary failure in name resolution' during HikariPool/Hibernate initialization, so the failure is at name resolution, not at the database: the Service tsdb-mysql-leader (10.68.188.173:3306) exists and a TCP probe from debug pods on worker-01/02/03 returns 'Connection Succeeded' on all three nodes, and a probe on the victim's own declared port 16579 fails from all three nodes. The same resolver failure is visible inside the same pod's istio-proxy as 'lookup istiod.istio-system.svc on 10.255.15.254:53: read udp 172.20.1.243:xxxxx->10.255.15.254:53: i/o timeout'. Root-cause config face: GetAppYAML(ts-price-service) uniquely declares 'dnsPolicy: "None"' with 'dnsConfig.nameservers: [10.255.15.254]' in its pod template, while ts-order-service, ts-preserve-service and ts-basic-service carry no dnsPolicy/dnsConfig (default ClusterFirst, resolving normally); the pod's ReplicaSet hash also changed (6c4b77845 -> 69f6579f8), i.e. the template was modified shortly before the incident. Mechanism closes on the event surface: 'Unhealthy ... pod/ts-price-service-69f6579f8-xv9gc Startup probe failed: dial tcp 172.20.1.243:15021: connect: connection refused'. Chain: pod DNS pointed at an unreachable nameserver -> service-name resolution fails -> app crash-loop -> no ready endpoints for ts-price-service.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-preserve-service
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: ts-preserve-service
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: ts-preserve-service
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ts-preserve-service
        image: ghcr.io/sregym/ts-preserve-service:latest
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        env:
        - name: SPRING_MAIN_ALLOW_CIRCULAR_REFERENCES
          value: 'true'
        - name: NODE_IP
          valueFrom:
            fieldRef:
              fieldPath: status.hostIP
        envFrom:
        - configMapRef:
            name: nacos
        - configMapRef:
            name: rabbitmq
        ports:
        - containerPort: 14568
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 350Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 500m
            memory: 512Mi
        readinessProbe:
          tcpSocket:
            port: 14568
          initialDelaySeconds: 60
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 5
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  namespace: train-ticket
  name: ts-preserve-service
spec:
  ports:
  - name: http
    port: 14568
  selector:
    app: ts-preserve-service
